data.name: SqlSelectCommand1.CommandText
data.value: SELECT IntermediaryContactGUID, IntermediaryID, DeliveryMethodID, LName + ', ' + FName AS Name, FName, LName, Title, Phone, Extension, Cell, Email, Salutation, StatusID, Fax, ContactSignature FROM dbo.tblIntermediaryContacts WHERE (IntermediaryID = @IntermediaryID) ORDER BY LName
